# memo's one-page design as it stood before 61f2e93 (`git show 61f2e93^:docs/one-page.html`), its claims transcribed
# into the text source's grammar with nothing marked planned, as that page marked nothing. It showed the aligner, the
# recall skill, the plugin, `memo export`, publishing and a land that prints cost as built, none of which were: a case
# the onepage-audit agent is to catch.
title memo, on one page

actor you    amber   the developer
actor agent  cyan    Claude Code
actor memo   green   the tool and its store
actor repo   violet  git

::: titleblock
cell id | memo
motto The memory of a project built with agents.
cell answer | Two places
big The @repo{repository} keeps what is true now; @memo{memo} keeps what happened.
para One store, in the main checkout's `.memo/`, found from any worktree through git's common directory and never committed. It is local SQLite behind the unit of work that pgx also satisfies, so a shared server would be an addition, not a rewrite. `memo export` hands history to another developer.
para memo keeps tasks, then their issue; runs and work files; retrospectives over the runs; notes of four kinds; and reads: what each run opened.
para Publishing is the one way out to other people: a task published to GitHub hands its state and assignee to the issue, and memo keeps the rest.
:::

::: details
detail A | When the code disagrees with the task | memo refuses a decision that cites no source and a question that shows no search, and flags a run that edits its signed criteria, deletes a test or adds a skip.
rung @agent | 1 · Decide | the run itself | Does the evidence rank it? ADRs, then guidance, then code and tests, then a precedent.
rung @memo | 2 · Aligner | memo's own agent | In a fresh context, given only the frame, the adaptation, guidance, ADRs and history. Its verdict reaches memo directly, never through the implementing agent: headless as structured output from its own run, interactive through memo itself.
rung @you | 3 · Escalate | you answer | Block on its questions, each with options, a lean, and the searches run; `memo inbox`, and you answer each in a line.
detail B | How an agent finds more | the start is chosen
rung @memo | Injected | memo | The task, its linked notes and what its dependencies decided.
rung @agent | Discovered | the discover agent | Maps memo's history with the code, in the frame; the map is kept with the run.
rung @agent | Reached | the recall skill | The recall skill says when to look: before choosing an approach, on a surprise, before escalating.
rung @memo | Measured | memo's read log | Every read is recorded against its run, so "did it look when it should have" is a query; `claude plugin eval` checks, with and without the plugin, that the recall skill triggers on the prompts it should.
:::

::: assembly
box template @repo A1 | GO-TEMPLATE | layout, recipes, hooks, settings, conventions
box plumb @repo B1 | PLUMB | arch and guidance tests, e2e, `just dev`
box plugin @agent C1 | MEMO PLUGIN | work, write-task, curate, retro and recall skills, | the discover agent, hooks
box why @memo A2 | MEMO WHY {1} | from code back to history
box brief @memo B2 | MEMO BRIEF {2} | brief in, work file out
arrow brief why
parts PARTS LIST | what memo is made of
part 1 @memo | `memo why` | code back to history | Code leads back to the reasons behind it.
part 2 @memo | `memo brief` | a task and its history | A run starts with history.
:::

::: spec
column
howto 6 | Land | `memo work land` @memo
caption memo re-runs the gates on the rebased diff and lands only on a pass and a recorded review.
```term
$ memo work land
landed  2 commits on main
adapted 1, for you
cost    $1.84, 41 min
```
howto 7 | Get /work in a new project | the plugin @you
caption A new project gets `/work` from the memo plugin.
:::
